name: chat-demo
title: ChatDemo
description: Reference composition of the chat pack: suggestions in the empty state, attachments (pick, paste or drop), a compact ModelPicker in the composer, a tool call, a streamed markdown reply with sources (TypingIndicator, caret), Stop, MessageFeedback (copy, regenerate, thumbs with reasons), and a resizable details panel. Streaming is mocked with timers that are cleaned up.
author: gntik-ai
